parsed_json.up: Define the compound set as parent CHEMBL221959 plus all its salts via molecule_hierarchy (parent_molregno from parent, molregno for children). Filter activities to standard_type IC50, standard_units nM, and target CHEMBL2971. Use FAQ salts provenance path: join molecule_dictionary to compound_records on molregno, compound_records.record_id to activities.record_id, and docs through compound_records.doc_id. Do not join activities on molregno and do not join docs via assays.doc_id. LEFT JOIN compound_structures for canonical_smiles. Join assays on activities.assay_id and target_dictionary on assays.tid. Return compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi (prefer pubmed_id, fallback to doi), assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id, target_name, target_organism. Sort by compound_chembl_id, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi, assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, target_chembl_id, target_name, target_organism. No row limit.
